chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ra'ab, from Abu Ubayda, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
Whichever animal becomes difficult for its owner due to bridling and fleeing (resisting commands)
let him recite in its ear or upon it
Is it other than Allah's Religion that they seek (to follow), and to Him submits whoever is in the skies and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and to Him shall they be returning.

key_terms.أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ اللَّهِ: Is it other than the Religion of Allah
key_terms.دَابَّةٍ: Animal (specifically a beast of burden or livestock)

ai.seo_question: How to train a disobedient animal according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines a spiritual remedy for animal resistance, prescribing the recitation of Surah Al-Imran 3:83 to invoke the creature's innate submission to God. By reminding the animal of the universal prostration of all beings in the heavens and earth, the owner aligns the animal's nature with divine will, a practice reflecting the Shia emphasis on utilizing Quranic verses for both physical and metaphysical healing.
